topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Innate immune recognition and pattern recognition receptor pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system detects pathogens and cellular damage through molecular patterns and specific pattern recognition receptor systems.

topics.label: Inflammatory mediator actions, leukocyte recruitment, and systemic consequences
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the cellular, vascular, and systemic events that occur during inflammatory activation and immune cell trafficking.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic inflammatory outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the mechanisms that terminate inflammatory responses, coordinate tissue repair, and lead to chronic inflammation or granulomas when resolution fails.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming topic on the complement system.
